recovery.issue.entryHint: Hand a one-time link to a member who forgot their password.
recovery.issue.confirmLead: This link lets {name} choose a new password. Check these points first.
recovery.issue.lineReplace: Any link you made before stops working.
recovery.issue.lineOnce: The link works once, within 24 hours.
recovery.issue.lineLogout: When the person sets a password, every device they are signed in on is signed out.
recovery.issue.lineVerify: Confirming who it is falls to you. Send the link only to someone you verified in person or by phone, not through a chat the account may be compromised in.
recovery.issue.lineOrder: If this member needs to be signed out everywhere, do that first and create the link afterwards. Doing it after the link exists disables the link too.
recovery.issue.passwordHint: Enter your own password as the admin creating the link.
recovery.issue.errorWrongPassword: That password is not correct. Try again.
recovery.issue.errorForbidden: You cannot create a reset link for this member. Your role does not allow it.
recovery.issue.errorNotFound: This member was not found in the roster. Refresh the roster and try again.
recovery.issue.errorInactive: This member is not active right now, so a link cannot be created.
recovery.issue.errorBadTarget: A reset link can only be created for a person.
recovery.issue.errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
recovery.issue.errorRateLimitedAfter: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds, number} seconds.
recovery.issue.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
recovery.issue.errorGeneric: Could not create the link. Try again in a moment.
recovery.issue.issuedLead: You can see this link only here, only now. It cannot be shown again once you close this, so pass it on now.
recovery.issue.issuedDeliver: Send it by messenger or hand it over in person.
recovery.issue.issuedLocalOnly: This address may open only on this computer or its network.
recovery.help.guideDetail: An admin can send you a link to set a new one.
recovery.help.adminTitle: Ask an admin for a link
recovery.help.adminBody: A workspace admin confirms it is you, then sends a one-time reset link. Copy the message below and pass it on.
recovery.help.requestWithEmail: I forgot my oort password and need a reset link. Server: {host}, email: {email}
recovery.help.requestNoEmail: I forgot my oort password and need a reset link. Server: {host}
recovery.help.receivedHint: The link works once, within 24 hours. When you set a new password, your other devices on this account are signed out.
recovery.help.receivedInvalid: This does not read as a reset link. Paste the link the admin sent, exactly as it came.
recovery.claim.title: Choose a new password.
recovery.claim.hostBody: Your new password is sent to the server below. Continue only if the address is the one your admin gave you.
recovery.claim.passwordHint: At least {min} characters and at most {maxBytes} bytes. A Korean syllable takes 3 bytes, so Korean-only fits {maxHangul} characters.
recovery.claim.resetExpired: This link expired after 24 hours. Ask an admin for a new link.
recovery.claim.resetUsed: This link was already used or replaced by a newer one. If you already set your password, sign in. Otherwise ask an admin for a new link.
recovery.claim.invalidChar: The password contains a character that cannot be used.
